definitionEn: to reach a goal, level or position, usually after a long effort
situation: After years of hard work, someone finally reaches a high level, an important goal or a senior position.

examples.text: Only about 5% of students [[attain]] the highest grade in the final exam.
She [[attained]] the rank of senior partner before she was forty.
The country hopes to [[attain]] carbon neutrality by 2050.

texts: Few writers have [[attained]] such fame so young.
The team finally [[attained]] its sales target in December.
She [[attained]] fluency in Japanese after five years in Tokyo.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Добиться встречи» — get или secure a meeting. Attain — достичь уровня, цели или положения: attain a goal.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Достичь высокого уровня — attain (или reach) a high level. Attend — посещать, win — выигрывать (приз), catch — ловить.

nuance.text: After ten years abroad, she had [[attained]] a level of fluency that amazed her teachers.
nuance.explanationRu: Attain — достичь уровня или цели после долгих усилий. Obtain — получить что-то конкретное (документ, разрешение, данные); уровень владения языком не obtain.

reverse.text: You need to [[obtain]] a visa before you travel to the country.
reverse.explanationRu: Получить документ — obtain a visa. Attain — достичь уровня или цели; визу не «достигают».

fixIt.text: Very few climbers ever [[attend]] that level of skill and fitness.
fixIt.explanationRu: Достичь уровня — attain a level. Attend — похожее по форме слово, но оно значит «посещать» (attend a class).

wordFormation.text: Set goals that are ambitious but [[attainable]].

rewrite.original: Very few students manage to get the top grade.
rewrite.frame: Very few students ____ the top grade.
rewrite.explanationRu: Attain — достичь высокого уровня или результата.

definitionEn: the number of people who come to an event or regularly visit a place
senseNote: Выбрано значение «число присутствующих, посещаемость (мероприятия, музея, занятий)»; базовое «присутствие на уроке» проще.
situation: Organisers count how many people came to a match, a concert, a conference or a museum.

examples.text: [[Attendance]] at the final was just over 60,000, a new record for the stadium.
Museum [[attendance]] has doubled since the new wing opened.
Despite the heavy rain, [[attendance]] at the conference was higher than expected.

texts: The league wants to boost [[attendance]] at women's matches.
Poor [[attendance]] forced the theatre to cancel the show.
[[Attendance]] at the festival was down by a third this year.

badCollocation.noteRu: Посещаемость музея — attendance at the museum (или museum attendance), с предлогом at, а не of.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Рекордная посещаемость — a record attendance. Attention — внимание, presence — присутствие, а visiting не используется как счётное существительное.

nuance.text: Class [[attendance]] drops sharply in the week before the holidays.
nuance.explanationRu: Attendance — посещаемость: занятий, музея, матчей. Turnout — явка, обычно на выборы или разовое мероприятие; о регулярных занятиях так не говорят.

reverse.text: Voter [[turnout]] was the lowest since the war.
reverse.explanationRu: Явка избирателей — voter turnout. Attendance о выборах не говорят: это посещаемость занятий, музеев, матчей.

fixIt.text: [[Presence]] at the festival dropped sharply this year because of the rain.
fixIt.explanationRu: Число пришедших на фестиваль — attendance. Presence — «присутствие» одного человека или вещи, а не посещаемость.

wordFormation.text: Evening classes have seen falling [[attendance]] since fees went up.

rewrite.original: About 50,000 people came to the final.

definitionEn: a lawyer, especially in the US, who acts for someone in legal matters or in court
senseNote: В американском английском attorney — обычное слово для адвоката; в британском чаще говорят lawyer или solicitor.
situation: Someone needs a legal professional to advise them or to represent them in an American court.

examples.text: Her [[attorney]] advised her to say nothing until the police had shown their evidence.
The company hired a top [[attorney]] to fight the lawsuit over its logo.
In the courtroom drama, a young defense [[attorney]] proves her client is innocent.

texts: Don't sign anything until you've spoken to your [[attorney]].
Her [[attorney]] filed an appeal the next morning.
The [[attorney]] asked the judge for more time.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Адвокат дьявола» — devil's advocate, а не attorney. Attorney — юрист, который ведёт дела клиента.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Адвокат защиты в США — a defense attorney. Notary — нотариус, prosecutor — обвинитель, judge — судья; их не нанимают для защиты.

nuance.text: His [[attorney]] asked the judge to delay the trial by a month.
nuance.explanationRu: Русское «адвокат» в суде — attorney (в США) или lawyer. Advocate в современном английском обычно «сторонник, защитник идеи»: an advocate of renewable energy.

reverse.text: She is a passionate [[advocate]] of renewable energy.
reverse.explanationRu: Сторонник идеи — advocate. Attorney — юрист, который ведёт дела клиента, а не защитник взглядов.

fixIt.text: My [[jurist]] says we have a strong case against the landlord.
fixIt.explanationRu: Юрист, который ведёт ваше дело, — attorney или lawyer. Jurist — учёный-правовед или судья; так своего юриста не называют.

reply.context: A friend texts: "My landlord won't return my deposit. What should I do?"
options: Just attorney him until he gives it back.
It is advisable to procure the services of legal counsel forthwith.
Talk to an attorney — many offer a free first consultation.
reply.explanationRu: Attorney — юрист, к нему можно обратиться за советом. Attorney не глагол, «attorney him» — ошибка. Второй ответ звучит как официальное письмо, а не сообщение другу.

definitionEn: to say or believe that something is the result of a particular cause
senseNote: Глагол (ударение на второй слог): «объяснять чем-то, приписывать». Существительное attribute — «качество, свойство».
situation: You explain what caused a success, a problem or a change, often in a report or an interview.

examples.text: Doctors [[attribute]] the rise in allergies partly to changes in diet.
She [[attributes]] her success to hard work and a good deal of luck.
The airline [[attributed]] the delays to a shortage of staff.

texts: Police [[attributed]] the accident to icy roads.
The rise in sales was [[attributed]] to the new advert.
Experts [[attributed]] the failure to poor planning.

badCollocation.noteRu: После attribute нужен предлог to: attribute the failure to bad luck. Русское «объяснять чем-то» сбивает на with или by.

collocationTask.prompt: The delay was ___ to bad weather
collocationTask.explanationRu: Be attributed to — «объясняться чем-то». Blame требует on (was blamed on), explain — by, а contribute to значит «способствовать».

nuance.text: Scientists [[attribute]] the warmer winters to rising levels of carbon dioxide.
nuance.explanationRu: Attribute X to Y — считать Y причиной X. Contribute to — «способствовать» и строится иначе: Carbon dioxide contributes to warmer winters.

reverse.text: Several factors [[contributed]] to the company's collapse.
reverse.explanationRu: Быть одной из причин — contribute to. Attribute требует схемы attribute X to Y: The collapse was attributed to several factors.

fixIt.text: The company [[blames]] its record profits to strong sales in Asia.
fixIt.explanationRu: Объяснять успех чем-то — attribute X to Y. Blame — «винить»: так говорят только о плохом и с предлогом on (blame the losses on the weather).

wordFormation.text: The drop in crime is largely [[attributable]] to better street lighting.

reply.context: At a job interview, you're asked: "Your team grew sales by 40%. What was the secret?"
options: I'd attribute our clients a big discount every month.
I'd attribute most of it to hiring two great people early on.
Luck, basically — no idea, to be honest.
reply.explanationRu: Attribute X to Y — объяснять успех какой-то причиной. Attribute не значит «давать» (скидку дают: give a discount). Третий ответ слишком небрежный для собеседования.

rewrite.original: Experts say the accident was caused by human error.
rewrite.explanationRu: Attribute X to Y — объяснять X причиной Y.

definitionEn: an official, detailed check of financial accounts or of how well a system works
situation: Independent experts check a company's accounts, or a system's safety, to make sure everything is correct.

examples.text: The annual [[audit]] found several errors in the company's accounts.
After the fire, the hospital carried out a full safety [[audit]] of all its buildings.
An energy [[audit]] showed that we were losing most of our heat through the roof.

texts: The tax office has ordered an [[audit]] of our accounts.
An independent [[audit]] found no evidence of fraud.
We do an [[audit]] of our suppliers every year.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Провести аудит» — carry out (или conduct) an audit. Hold подходит к встречам и выборам, а не к проверкам.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Провести проверку — carry out (или conduct) an audit. Hold — про встречи и выборы, make up — «выдумать», take up — «заняться (хобби)».

nuance.text: Independent experts will carry out an [[audit]] of the charity's finances.
nuance.explanationRu: Проверка финансов — audit. Revision — ложный друг русского «ревизия»: это «исправление, правка» или (в Британии) повторение материала перед экзаменом.

reverse.text: I need to do some [[revision]] before my history exam.
reverse.explanationRu: Повторять материал перед экзаменом — do revision. Audit — официальная проверка счетов или систем, к учёбе она не относится.

fixIt.text: The tax office announced a full [[control]] of the company's accounts.
fixIt.explanationRu: Проверка счетов — audit. Control — «управление, контроль» как власть над чем-то, а не разовая проверка.

wordFormation.text: The [[auditors]] found that money was missing from the charity's accounts.

definitionEn: real and exactly what it claims to be, not false or an imitation
situation: Experts confirm that a painting, a document or a dish is genuinely what it claims to be.

examples.text: After months of tests, experts confirmed that the letter was [[authentic]] and not a clever fake.
This tiny café serves the most [[authentic]] Georgian food in the city.
Teachers often use [[authentic]] materials, such as real news articles, in their lessons.

texts: Nobody could tell whether the signature was [[authentic]].
The market sells [[authentic]] Mexican crafts made by local families.
Visitors want something [[authentic]], not a tourist show.

badCollocation.noteRu: Натуральная кожа — genuine leather: о материалах говорят genuine, а authentic — о документах, картинах, блюдах.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Подлинная картина — authentic. Actual — «фактический» (не «актуальный»), truthful — «правдивый» о людях и словах, authorized — «разрешённый».

nuance.text: The restaurant serves [[authentic]] Thai curry, cooked by a chef from Bangkok.
nuance.explanationRu: Authentic — настоящий, такой, как в стране происхождения. Original — «необычный, новаторский» или «первоначальный»; original Thai curry звучит как «оригинальное карри».

reverse.text: Her designs are fresh, bold and very [[original]].
reverse.explanationRu: Смелые, новые, ни на что не похожие идеи — original. Authentic значит «подлинный, настоящий», а не «оригинальный, творческий».

fixIt.text: The experts confirmed that the signature on the letter was [[truthful]].
fixIt.explanationRu: Подлинная подпись — an authentic signature. Truthful — «правдивый», так говорят о людях и их словах.

wordFormation.text: Historians still question the [[authenticity]] of the diary.

reply.context: A friend asks: "Is that new ramen place any good?"
options: It's great — really authentic, the chef trained in Osaka for ten years.
It's great — really authentic, they only opened last week so everything's brand new.
It is of an authentic character, I would venture to propose.
reply.explanationRu: Authentic — настоящий, как в Японии, поэтому подходит первый ответ. Новизна ресторана к authentic отношения не имеет, а третий ответ слишком чопорный для разговора с другом.

definitionEn: to give official permission for something to happen or be done
situation: A manager, a bank or a government officially allows a payment, a plan or an action to go ahead.

examples.text: The bank must [[authorize]] any payment over $10,000 before it goes through.
Only the store manager can [[authorize]] refunds without a receipt.
The city council has [[authorized]] the construction of a new bridge over the river.

texts: Only [[authorized]] staff may enter this area.
Who [[authorized]] this payment to the supplier?
The president [[authorized]] the release of the documents.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Авторизоваться на сайте» — log in (или sign in). Authorize — официально разрешить что-то: платёж, доступ, расходы.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Официально разрешить платёж — authorize a payment. Let требует конструкции let someone do, admit — «признавать, впускать», consent нужен с to.

nuance.text: Only an administrator can [[authorize]] new users to see these files.
nuance.explanationRu: Authorize — дать кому-то официальное право или доступ. Log in — войти в систему самому; «авторизоваться на сайте» по-английски — log in, а не authorize.

reverse.text: Please [[log in]] with your email address and password.
reverse.explanationRu: Войти в аккаунт — log in или sign in. Authorize — дать разрешение кому-то или на что-то; «авторизуйтесь» так не переводится.

fixIt.text: The bank refused to [[resolve]] the payment because the card details were wrong.
fixIt.explanationRu: Русское «разрешить» бывает двух видов: дать разрешение — authorize, найти решение проблемы — resolve. Банк не «решает» платёж, а разрешает его.

wordFormation.text: Staff need written [[authorization]] to enter the building at night.

reply.context: A customer says: "This phone stopped working after two days. Can I get my money back?"
options: I'm afraid I can't authorize — our website is down today.
Negative. Refund authorization falls outside my jurisdiction, madam.
I'm afraid I can't authorize refunds myself — let me call my manager.
reply.explanationRu: Authorize refunds — разрешать возвраты денег. В первом ответе authorize понято как «авторизоваться на сайте» (это log in). Второй звучит грубо-официально для разговора с покупателем.

rewrite.original: The director gave official permission for the payment.

definitionEn: the freedom to make your own decisions without being controlled by others
senseNote: Выбрано значение «самостоятельность в решениях» (у человека, команды, школы); политическая автономия региона — близкое значение.
situation: People, teams or institutions can decide for themselves how to do things, without someone controlling every step.

examples.text: Employees are usually happier when they have more [[autonomy]] over how they do their work.
The reform gives schools more [[autonomy]] in choosing their own textbooks.
As teenagers get older, they naturally want more [[autonomy]] from their parents.

texts: Good managers give their teams real [[autonomy]].
Patients should have [[autonomy]] over decisions about their treatment.
Freelancing offers more [[autonomy]] but less security.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Автономность» телефона или машины — battery life или range, а не autonomy. Autonomy — самостоятельность людей и организаций.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Больше самостоятельности — greater autonomy. Autocracy — самодержавие, automation — автоматизация, autonomous — прилагательное.

nuance.text: Within the company, each team has full [[autonomy]] over its own budget.
nuance.explanationRu: Autonomy — свобода самим решать внутри большой системы: autonomy over the budget. Independence — полная отделённость от кого-то (independence from), поэтому independence over звучит неверно.

fixIt.text: The new law gives universities more [[sovereignty]] over their admissions.
fixIt.explanationRu: Самостоятельность университетов или команд — autonomy. Sovereignty — суверенитет государства, к университетам он не подходит.

wordFormation.text: The city plans to test [[autonomous]] buses on two routes next year.

reply.context: At a job interview, you're asked: "Why do you want to leave your current job?"
options: I'd like more autonomy — my car is old and I spend hours in traffic.
I'd like more autonomy — right now every small decision needs three signatures.
Autonomy, basically — my boss drives me mad, to be honest.
reply.explanationRu: Autonomy — свобода принимать решения самому. К машине и пробкам слово не относится. Третий ответ слишком откровенный и небрежный для собеседования.

rewrite.original: Each department can make its own decisions about hiring.
rewrite.explanationRu: Have autonomy over something — самостоятельно решать какой-то вопрос.

definitionEn: the fact that something can be obtained, bought or used, or how much of it there is
senseNote: Выбрано значение «наличие, доступность (товаров, мест, ресурсов)»; о свободном времени человека (your availability) — отдельное значение.
situation: You check whether tickets, rooms, products or services can still be booked, bought or used.

examples.text: Room [[availability]] is limited during the festival, so book as early as you can.
Prices depend largely on the [[availability]] of raw materials such as steel and copper.
The [[availability]] of cheap flights has changed the way young people travel.

texts: Please check [[availability]] before you book the tickets.
All prices and offers are subject to [[availability]].
Better [[availability]] of fresh fruit has improved children's diets.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Наличие проблем» — the existence (или presence) of problems. Availability — о том, что можно получить или купить: availability of tickets.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Стандартная оговорка — subject to availability, «при наличии мест или товара». Presence, existence и accessibility в этой фразе не используются.

nuance.text: Please check the [[availability]] of tickets before you plan the trip.
nuance.explanationRu: Availability — есть ли что-то в наличии, можно ли это получить. Accessibility — удобство доступа, особенно для людей с инвалидностью; к наличию билетов это не относится.

reverse.text: The museum has improved [[accessibility]] for wheelchair users.
reverse.explanationRu: Доступность здания для людей на колясках — accessibility. Availability — наличие чего-то, а не удобство входа.

fixIt.text: Prices change depending on the [[presence]] of seats on the flight.
fixIt.explanationRu: Наличие свободных мест — availability of seats. Presence — «присутствие» человека или вещи, а не возможность купить.

wordFormation.text: The [[availability]] of free Wi-Fi was the main reason we chose the hotel.

reply.context: A friend says: "Shall we book that cabin in the mountains for New Year?"
options: Let's check its availability first — I want to know if the owners are friendly.
Let's check availability first — last year it was fully booked by October.
I shall ascertain the availability of the aforementioned cabin forthwith.
reply.explanationRu: Check availability — проверить, есть ли свободные даты. Дружелюбие хозяев к availability не относится, а третий ответ звучит как канцелярское письмо.

rewrite.original: It's hard to find fresh fish in the village in winter.
rewrite.frame: The ____ fresh fish in the village is limited in winter.
rewrite.explanationRu: Availability of something — наличие, возможность это купить.

definitionEn: very keen on a hobby or activity and doing it as often as possible
situation: Someone loves a hobby, such as reading, cycling or collecting, and spends a lot of time on it.

examples.text: My grandfather was an [[avid]] reader who got through three detective novels a week.
As an [[avid]] cyclist, she rides to work even in the middle of winter.
The auction attracted [[avid]] collectors of vintage film posters from all over Europe.

texts: He's an [[avid]] fan of Italian football.
She's been an [[avid]] gardener since she retired.
As an [[avid]] traveller, he has visited sixty countries.

badCollocation.noteRu: Avid обычно стоит перед существительным: an avid football fan, а не avid in football.

collocationTask.prompt: My aunt is an ___ collector of old postcards.
collocationTask.explanationRu: Заядлый коллекционер — an avid collector. Urgent — срочный, extreme — крайний, aggressive — агрессивный; смысла «увлечённый» они не дают.

nuance.text: Both my uncles are [[avid]] collectors of vinyl records from the 1960s.
nuance.explanationRu: Avid — увлечённый хобби: avid collector, avid reader. Heavy говорят о вредных привычках: heavy smoker, heavy drinker. «Заядлый» переводится по-разному.

reverse.text: Both his parents were [[heavy]] smokers, so he never touched cigarettes.
reverse.explanationRu: О вредной привычке — heavy smoker. Avid подчёркивает увлечённость и удовольствие от хобби; о курении так не говорят.

fixIt.text: My parents are [[hot]] fans of Italian cinema from the 1960s.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Горячие поклонники» — avid (или big, huge) fans. Hot fans по-английски звучит странно: hot — «горячий» или «привлекательный».

wordFormation.text: She reads [[avidly]], usually two or three novels a week.

reply.context: A new colleague asks: "So what do you do at weekends?"
options: I'm pretty avid, so I mostly stay at home and rest.
I am an avid practitioner of recreational hiking, as it were.
I'm an avid hiker, so I'm usually somewhere in the mountains.
reply.explanationRu: Avid hiker — заядлый любитель походов. Avid само по себе не значит «ленивый» или «уставший», ему нужно существительное-хобби. Второй ответ звучит неестественно книжно.
